about: Stair watch list (BUILD-STAIR-WALK-SCOPE-KEY-46): places that stair and walkway bugs reported. Every build walks the CHIM frames and the maps (interiors) holding them again, even when their walk is reused, and stops when a walk again differs from its record; tools/build.py --stair-walk-places ID walks one of them on its own. A place with refs is held by every frame that places one of those source references; a place without refs by the frames of its cells; maps names interior maps the image step walks (tools/stair_parallel.py). A bug page that reports a stair or walkway problem adds its place here. Read by chim.collision.load_watch.
